name: 86 Chaos 17.0.36
label: 86 Chaos 17.0.36
releaseTitle: Complete System Administrator Directory and Desktop Repair
notes: Expands the main System Administrator page from the incomplete seven-card subset to all 21 internal admin subpages, grouped by purpose in the same Concept 1 card language.

Removes the native all-tools select from admin subpages so desktop can no longer expand a giant browser selector over the page; subpages now show a stable current-location panel and one-click return to the complete admin directory.

Further unifies desktop and mobile subpage panels, tables, forms, diagnostic cards, and navigation surfaces under the same charcoal/bronze Concept 1 styling while preserving all existing tools and navigation behavior.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.36
summary: Restores a complete System Administrator home directory, removes the desktop-breaking native tool selector, and keeps every admin subpage in one Concept 1 visual system.
description: Shows all System Administrator tools on the main page in grouped Concept 1 cards, replaces the desktop-breaking all-tools native select with a stable location/home control, and tightens responsive styling so every internal admin page follows the same charcoal/bronze design language.
